messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a three‑day weekend; if they fall on a weekend, the following Monday is usually observed):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Louis Riel Day** (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | — |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Mar 17 (Friday) | — | — |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | — |
| **Easter Monday** (Federal employees) | Apr 10 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| **Civic Holiday** (most provinces) | Aug 7 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 13 (Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | — |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | — |

**Long‑weekend highlights**

- **Jan 1–3** (New Year’s) – 3 days (Fri–Mon)
- **Feb 20** (Family/Louis Riel) – 3 days (Mon–Wed)
- **Mar 17** (St. Patrick’s) – 3 days (Fri–Sun)
- **Apr 7–10** (Good Friday + Easter Monday) – 5 days (Fri–Mon)
- **May 22** (Victoria) – 3 days (Mon–Wed)
- **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day) – 3 days (Sat–Mon)
- **Aug 7** (Civic) – 3 days (Mon–Wed)
- **Sep 4** (Labour) – 3 days (Mon–Wed)
- **Oct 9** (Thanksgiving) – 3 days (Mon–Wed)
- **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance) – 3 days (Sat–Mon)
- **Dec 25–26** (Christmas/Boxing) – 3 days (Mon–Tue)

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
